title: Adani begins construction of 10,432 Dharavi rehabilitation homes in Mumbai
description:
Adani Enterprises Director Pranav Adani on Monday performed the bhoomi poojan for a 22-acre rehabilitation housing project in Matunga, marking the start of construction of 10,432 homes for eligible residents of Dharavi, one of Asia's largest informal settlements.
The project, being implemented by Adani Navbharat Developers Pvt Ltd (ANDPL), a special purpose vehicle set up for the Dharavi Redevelopment Project, will comprise 10 towers housing 10,432 rehabilitation apartments and 1,379 commercial and industrial units, according to a company statement.
"Every family deserves a home where they feel secure and can plan for the future. We know what this means to Dharavi's families. At Matunga, we are building 10 towers with 10,432 homes and 1,379 commercial and industrial units, creating neighbourhoods where families can live better and build a brighter future for their children," Pranav Adani said.
